prompt: Two participants named Kai have prints at opposite ends of the wall. The Kai on the left has a last name that comes later alphabetically. How should the entries be documented?
promptZh: 兩位名叫凱的參加者分別把相片掛在展牆的兩端。左側那位的姓按字母排列較後。應如何標記並編列這兩件作品？

options.text: Write their last initials on the prints and list the right-hand entry first.
options.zh: 把兩人的姓氏首字母寫在相片上，並把右側作品列在前面。
options.whyZh: 不能在相片上寫字；節目單也不按姓名字母排序。

options.text: Add their last initials to the removable cards and preserve wall order in the program.
options.zh: 在可取下的卡片各加上姓氏首字母，節目單照展牆順序編列。
options.whyZh: 同名以卡上的姓氏首字母區分，不寫在相片上；節目單要依牆面排列順序。

options.text: Add their last initials to the cards but sort the program by the initials.
options.zh: 在卡片各加上姓氏首字母，但節目單按首字母排序。
options.whyZh: 卡片作法正確，節目單排序卻違反依牆面順序的規定。

options.text: Write the layout slot numbers on both prints and preserve wall order in the program.
options.zh: 把牆位編號寫在兩張相片上，節目單則照展牆順序編列。
options.whyZh: 節目單順序正確，但位置編號只寫在配置草圖上；同名應用卡片辨識。

explanationZh: 同名以卡上的姓氏首字母區分，不寫在相片上；節目單要依牆面排列順序。
evidence: The preparation team numbers the slots on its layout sketch, not on the prints. / If two participants share a given name, the guide will add their last initials to the cards. / The printed program keeps the entries in wall order, not in alphabetical order.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The preparation team numbers the slots on its layout sketch, not on the prints.
If two participants share a given name, the guide will add their last initials to the cards.
The printed program keeps the entries in wall order, not in alphabetical order.

vocabulary.note: initial 指姓名中某部分的第一個字母；此處為姓氏。
